question: What ritual procedure must follow installing the root liṅga when the original remains unfound?
premises: The root liṅga and related items have been installed.
Prescribed worship procedures already exist in the ritual texts.
Worship must conform to those established prescriptions.
inference: After installing the root liṅga and related items, one should perform worship according to the prescribed manner.
plain_english: Having installed the root liṅga and so forth, one should worship it in the manner prescribed for worship.
